title: Flexible Organic SERP & Direct Traffic Generator

startUrls.title: Target URLs (Destination Websites)
startUrls.description: The web pages you want to visit and drive traffic to. In Simulated Referral, SERP, Direct, or Backlink modes, these are the final destinations your visitors land on.

trafficSource.title: Traffic Source Mode
trafficSource.description:
Choose how to drive traffic:
• Simulated Referral (Recommended & 100% Reliable): Navigates directly to your target URLs with authentic HTTP Referer headers (Google Organic Search, Bing, Social, Reddit, Medium). Classified as Organic Search in GA4 and ad networks.
• Google SERP: Attempts live Google search on google.com and clicks the organic result (requires clean residential proxies; falls back fast to direct visit with Google referrer if Google drops connection).
• Backlink Traffic: Navigates to a physical source page (e.g. Medium, Reddit, LinkedIn) and clicks your link.
• Direct Traffic: Clean direct visit without any referrer header.
enumTitles: Simulated Referral Traffic (Google Search / Social / Blogs Referrer — Recommended)
SERP Traffic (Google Search → Organic Result Click)
Backlink Traffic (Navigate to Source Page & Click Link)

referrerSource.title: Referrer Preset / Source
referrerSource.description: Only used when Traffic Source is 'Simulated Referral Traffic'. Choose a pool of high-authority referrers to rotate, or choose 'Custom' to enter specific URLs.
enumTitles: Search Engines (Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia) — 100% Organic Search in GA4 & Adsterra
Popular Social Networks (LinkedIn, Reddit, Medium, Twitter/X, Facebook, Quora, Pinterest)
Tech Platforms & Blogs (Medium, Substack, Dev.to, Hashnode, WordPress)
referrerSource.sectionCaption: 2. Simulated Referral Settings (Optional — Only for Simulated Referral Mode)

customReferrers.title: Custom Referrer URL(s) (Optional)
customReferrers.description: Enter one or more custom referrer URLs (comma or newline separated). E.g. your Medium post: https://medium.com/@username/post-slug. When specified, sessions will simulate arriving from these pages without ever hitting their servers.

serpCustomQuery.title: SERP Custom Search Query (Optional)
serpCustomQuery.description: Only used in Google SERP mode. Leave blank to automatically search 'site:{targetUrl}'. Or enter custom keywords (e.g. 'best puppy training tips').
serpCustomQuery.sectionCaption: 3. Google SERP Settings (Optional — Only for Google SERP Mode)

backlinkUrl.title: Backlink Source Page URL (Optional)
backlinkUrl.description: Only used when Traffic Source is 'Backlink Traffic'. Enter the URL of the external page (e.g. Medium, Reddit, LinkedIn, forum post) where your link is published. The Actor will open this page first and click the link to reach your Target URL.
backlinkUrl.sectionCaption: 4. Backlink Click Settings (Optional — Only for Backlink Mode)

backlinkAnchorText.title: Link Anchor Text (Optional)
backlinkAnchorText.description: The visible text of your link on the backlink page (e.g. 'Read More' or 'Dog Breeds Chart'). If left empty, the Actor automatically finds and clicks any link pointing to your Target URL.

deviceType.title: Device & Browser Profile
deviceType.description: Choose the browser and device profile to emulate. Matches viewport, touch events, platform headers, and user-agent strings.
enumTitles: Mobile Android (Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra & Google Pixel 8 Pro)
Mobile Apple iOS (iPhone 16 Pro & iPad Air)

customUserAgent.title: Custom User-Agent Override (Optional)
customUserAgent.description: Leave empty to use the realistic device profiles above. Or paste an exact custom User-Agent string to override.

dwellTimeMinSeconds.title: Landing Page Min Dwell Time (seconds)
dwellTimeMinSeconds.description: Minimum seconds to spend interacting and reading the landing page.

dwellTimeMaxSeconds.title: Landing Page Max Dwell Time (seconds)
dwellTimeMaxSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to spend on the landing page. A random duration between min and max is chosen per session for organic variance.

scrollBehavior.title: Scroll & User Activity Pattern
scrollBehavior.description: Human-like scroll pauses, reverses slightly (reading behavior), and moves the mouse cursor randomly.

enableInternalNavigation.title: Navigate Internal Pages (Deep Browsing)
enableInternalNavigation.description: After landing on the target page, should the browser discover and click internal links to simulate multi-page visitor sessions?

maxInternalPages.title: Max Internal Pages to Visit
maxInternalPages.description: How many internal pages deep to explore per session (e.g. 1-3). Increases session duration and reduces bounce rate in analytics.

internalPageDwellMinSeconds.title: Internal Page Min Dwell (seconds)
internalPageDwellMinSeconds.description: Minimum dwell time spent reading each visited internal page.

internalPageDwellMaxSeconds.title: Internal Page Max Dwell (seconds)
internalPageDwellMaxSeconds.description: Maximum dwell time spent on each internal page.

repeatVisits.title: Repeat Visits (per URL)
repeatVisits.description: Number of browser sessions per URL.

maxConcurrentSessions.title: Max Concurrent Sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.description: Number of browser sessions running in parallel (Default: 1, Max: 3). Kept low to prevent container memory exhaustion, proxy socket saturation, and anti-bot rate-limiting.

navigationTimeoutSeconds.title: Navigation Timeout (seconds)
navigationTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for each page to load before timing out.

waitAfterNavigationSeconds.title: Extra Wait for Ad & Analytics Scripts (seconds)
waitAfterNavigationSeconds.description: Additional wait after page load for analytics and ad scripts to inject their content.

maxRunDurationSeconds.title: Max Total Actor Runtime (seconds)
maxRunDurationSeconds.description: Hard limit for the entire Actor run. Remaining sessions are skipped if reached.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Times to retry on transient network errors.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description:
Proxy settings. Supports Apify Datacenter/Residential proxies or your own Custom Proxies (e.g. Bright Data, Smartproxy, Webshare, Oxylabs).
• For 'Simulated Referral Traffic', datacenter proxies or no proxy work 100% reliably.
• For live Google SERP, clean dedicated/private residential proxies are recommended to prevent Google dropping the connection.

captureScreenshots.title: Capture Screenshots
captureScreenshots.description: Save JPEG screenshots before and after scrolling, plus internal pages, in Key-Value Store.

captureConsoleErrors.title: Capture Console Errors
captureConsoleErrors.description: Record browser JS console errors during each session.

captureNetworkFailures.title: Capture Network Failures
captureNetworkFailures.description: Record failed network requests (blocked scripts, DNS errors, etc.).
